verdict.rationale: Filee's CLI converts files, wildcards or whole folders in one command. Its --json output and exit codes distinguish 'some files failed' from success. The GUI also handles 100 files in parallel, and one failure never stops the rest. Missing for 10: an explicit documented per-file JSON result schema, and independent hands-on corroboration of batch runs.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can convert a whole folder or list of files in one run, with per-file results

citations.quote: "filee convert <files, wildcards or folders> --to <format>" (or "--preset <preset>") converts with the app's engines and presets
"--json" prints the result for scripts; exit codes are 0 (nothing failed), 1 (some files failed)
Drop 1 file or 100. They're converted in parallel, a failure never stops the rest
